create.name: Ananda Sangha Ahmedabad
create.bio:
Ananda Sangha Ahmedabad is the Gujarat branch of Ananda Sangha, the worldwide movement Swami Kriyananda started in 1968 to pass on the Kriya Yoga teachings of his guru, Paramhansa Yogananda. The group began meeting in 2018 in a small flat and, as numbers grew, moved to a larger dedicated meditation hall in Bodakdev, in the west of the city; members now hope to buy land and build a centre of their own.

The centre is led by Nayaswami Devendra, a Kriyacharya who has practised Kriya Yoga for some twenty years and helped set up Ananda groups in several other Indian cities. Newcomers start with a two-part Learn to Meditate class, taught in English or Hindi, which introduces the Hong-Sau concentration technique and Yogananda's Energization Exercises as the first step towards Kriya initiation. After that, students can join group meditations most mornings and some evenings, mainly on Zoom with one in-person sitting each week.

A free Sunday-morning satsang at the hall, also streamed online, brings chanting, a short meditation and a talk drawn from the Bhagavad Gita and Yogananda's teachings. Music matters here too: kirtan evenings and occasional harmonium classes support the devotional side of the path.

courses.title: Learn to Meditate (The Path of Kriya Yoga: Level 1)
courses.description: A two-part introductory class, in English or Hindi, teaching a simple concentration technique, ways to relax and energise body and mind, guided practice and tips for daily meditation, followed by ongoing support through the centre's group sittings. The first step towards Kriya Yoga; new dates are announced on the page.

courses.title: Chanting, kirtan and harmonium classes
courses.description: Devotional chanting of songs by Yogananda and Kriyananda alongside traditional chants, with regular kirtan evenings and periodic beginners' classes in harmonium and cymbals to accompany the chants.

free_resources.title: Sunday Satsang
free_resources.description: A weekly Sunday-morning gathering at the Ahmedabad centre, also on Zoom, with chants, a short meditation, an affirmation and a talk by one of Ananda's acharyas on Yogananda's teachings and the Bhagavad Gita. Free; all welcome.

free_resources.title: Group Meditations for students
free_resources.description: Regular sittings for those who have learned meditation with Ananda: early-morning sessions from Tuesday to Friday that begin with the Energization Exercises, and evening meditations on Thursdays and Saturdays, held on Zoom. Free of charge.
